blockers.description: CMS crashes with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT for 'lodash/fp' in @strapi/core/dist/index.mjs (bare import, not 'from' import — sed missed it)
blockers.workaround: In Dockerfile, change sed pattern from `s|from 'lodash/fp'|from 'lodash/fp.js'|g` to `s|'lodash/fp'|'lodash/fp.js'|g` (removes the 'from' prefix so it catches bare imports too). SCP to VPS, rebuild, start CMS.

decisions.rationale: node:20.20.1 introduced stricter ESM resolution breaking lodash imports
Without it JS controllers (automation.js, agent-session.js etc.) never land in dist/ — Strapi production only loads from dist/

decisions.decision: Set auth: false (not true/string) in Strapi 5 route configs
decisions.rationale: Strapi 5 validateRouteConfig rejects boolean true and string values for config.auth

decisions.decision: Patch @strapi/core dist .mjs files in Dockerfile to rewrite lodash/fp directory import
decisions.rationale: Node.js 20+ ESM resolver rejects directory imports; lodash/fp.js is the valid entry point
